quick_check.question: Insert 1 into the min-heap [2,5,3,9,7,4]. Which indices are compared, and what is the array afterwards?
quick_check.answer: [1,5,2,9,7,4,3], with comparisons against index 3 (value 3) and then index 1 (value 2).
quick_check.note: The climb stops at the root after two swaps, the height of a seven-key heap
